title: Comprehensive assessment of precious metal concentration, distribution, and recovery potential in municipal solid waste incineration residues from northern Vietnam
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2937-2957
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08421K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thi Thu Thuy Nguyen, Truong Xuan Vuong, Thi Thu Ha Pham, Anh Quoc Hoang, Minh Binh Tu, Thi Hue Nguyen
Precious-metal concentrations in PM10, fly ash, and bottom ash from MSWI in Northern Vietnam show strong inter-metal correlations and significant recovery potential, supporting waste valorization and circular-economy strategies.
